_about: A beast's weapon is its racial skill (Battle Brothers: a Direwolf carries no gear and bites). Copied from the skill pages in the repo, one weapon-shaped row per page (class natural, no hands, reach one unless the page says two); by_enemy names each gearless enemy's lead attack. effects_not_built lists what the page says the attack also does that the fight does not build yet. refused: a gearless enemy with no damage page.

rows.name: Corpse Hurl
rows.effect: Corpse Hurl is a ranged attack. Does 55-65 Damage with 110% Armor Damage and 40% Direct Damage if hits. Additionally does 20-40 Damage with 50% Armor Damage and 25% Direct Damage, ignoring Nimble, in a 7 tiles area where the corpse landed, even if the attack misses. Creates a corpse and can be used without any corpses nearby. Range is 4 tiles, 5 with height advantage.
